note_text:
lore-lore deploy, restart and resource ceiling. Measured 2026-08-08 (packet 05a-iii); the image ids below are state as of that date. Point (5) was refreshed 2026-11-09 against Claude Code 2.1.319.

(1) DEPLOY: lore-lore is the hand-rolled #165/#166 exception.
- Recreate it MANUALLY from its captured CreateCommand: `podman inspect lore-lore --format '{{.Config.CreateCommand}}'`. It carries both the `/source` and the `/home/lore/docker/mcp/lore-snapshot` mounts.
- Do NOT use `lore-deploy start`: it re-mounts /source and breaks boot again.
- Build first (the old container keeps serving), tag the old image as rollback, then stop, rm and recreate on `localhost/lore:latest`.
- Verify tini is PID 1: `podman exec lore-lore cat /proc/1/comm`.
- As of 2026-08-08: image a04a23ca; rollback tag `pre-05aiii-rollback`=9debdd34.

(2) RESTART GOTCHA: a plain `podman start` can fail on a wedged conmon. Podman then shows a phantom "Up" while `podman exec` says "container is not running". Fix: `podman stop` (which reaps the stale conmon), then `podman start`.

(3) RESOURCE CEILING: `PidsLimit=2048` is the only binding limit; procs and threads count together.
- The 2026-08-07 self-shutdown is HYPOTHESISED as pids.max exhaustion by a task leak (finding #340), not zombie processes.
- Diagnostic: monitor the task count toward 2048. Steady state is about 7 procs / 6 threads.
- Stopgap: raise `--pids-limit`.

(4) lore-lore has NO restart policy and is not systemd-managed (finding #339). Any stop is a silent outage. A recreate after divergence can trigger a one-time full re-index of about 2.7h.

(5) Claude Code side, refreshed 2026-11-09:
- The mcp doc says remote MCP servers reconnect automatically after a mid-session disconnect. 2.1.273 adds a notification when automatic reconnection gives up.
- `/mcp reconnect all` (2.1.284) retries every failed server at once, with no Claude restart.
- Not documented: whether automatic reconnection covers a server that was DOWN AT SESSION START. Use `/mcp reconnect all` once lore is up.
- Companion memory 50faec1f: lore-lore itself may not reconnect to lore-surreal after a store restart (#250/#164).
